author: KEXP
description: Indonesian surf-rock band The Panturas deliver a high-energy performance in our latest Live on KEXP session at AXEAN Festival. Watch them perform "Soma Gospel" and more now.
title: The Panturas perform "Soma Gospel" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with The Panturas performing at Locca Sea House. Recorded August 27, 2026.

Songs:
Khodam Buntut Lutung 00:42
Soma Gospel 04:14
Fisherman Slut 07:36
Tafsir Mistik 10:00
Bentang Sagara 14:18

Abyan Zaki - Guitar, Vocal
Rizal Taufik - Guitar
Surya Fikri Asshidiq - Drums
Bagus Patria - Bass
Panji Wisnu - Keyboard, Additional Player

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN. Recorded at Locca Sea House, in Bali, Indonesia

Audio Engineer:  Matt Ogaz
Guest Audio Engineer: Virgi D. E.
